user_stated_intent: The newest sequence includes repeated SICK attempts and comparisons with FATHER, MOTHER, and FEEL; exact intended label per event was not recorded.

session_summary.sick_cluster_observation: Repeated candidates cluster around SICK, FATHER, WHY, KNOW, and THINK. One early attempt was accepted as SICK; several later attempts placed SICK first but rejected it, or placed FATHER/WHY above SICK.

training_handedness.interpretation: The user's one-handed SICK reduction is underrepresented and is structurally closer to the one-handed forehead/face classes in the current local adaptation.

existing_one_hand_sick_candidates.role: Useful training candidates after review, not sufficient alone and not a general PopSign promotion.

existing_citizen_visual_validation.decision: Do not activate the current visual teachers for this confusion set. A retrained detailed-face/lip supplement needs its own validation gate.

diagnosis: This is a domain/variant coverage gap, not a label-index mismatch.
The cascade is behaving as configured but transfers poorly on this live session: 63.6% fallback versus 11.4% on Citizen validation.
The current history does not store intended labels or exact per-clip tensors, so it is diagnostic evidence but not safe supervised retraining data.

recommended_retrain.primary: Add reviewed one-handed SICK performances and balanced hard negatives FATHER, MOTHER, FEEL, WHY, KNOW, and THINK; train handshape plus hand-to-face-location discrimination without removing two-handed SICK.
recommended_retrain.targeted_augmentation: For two-handed SICK training clips, sometimes preserve the hand nearest the face and mask the lower/stomach hand. Existing augmentation drops a few random nodes but never models this complete one-hand lexical reduction.
recommended_retrain.supplement: Train a separate Apple Vision detailed face/lip motion expert and promote it only if it improves the focused confusion gate without reducing all-class signer-disjoint validation.
recommended_retrain.collection_requirement: Future labeled live clips should save exact v17 tensors, hand crops, detailed lip landmarks, boundaries, and intended gloss; the current low-resolution session MP4 is reference-only.
